title: Pip the Hedgehog's Heavy Shell
description: Pip collects too many pretty pebbles for his backpack until he realizes traveling light makes the journey much sweeter.
character_reference: a tiny round hedgehog with golden-brown quills, round spectacles perched on his nose, and a little blue canvas knapsack

scenes.narration: Pip waddled down the forest trail, his tiny canvas bag stuffed completely full of shiny smooth river stones.
scenes.visual: side profile of a small hedgehog leaning forward under the weight of a bulging fabric knapsack

scenes.narration: Every time he found a pretty pebble, he simply had to pick it up and add it to his growing collection.
scenes.visual: close-up of small paws carefully placing a wet gray river stone into an already overflowing bag

scenes.narration: Soon his little legs began to wobble, and walking up the gentle grassy hill felt like climbing a mountain.
scenes.visual: low angle shot showing the struggling posture while climbing a steep incline of green moss

scenes.narration: He sat down on a broad dock leaf to catch his breath, feeling much too tired to enjoy the lovely evening.
scenes.visual: slumped posture sitting on a green leaf with glasses sliding down the snout

scenes.narration: With a gentle smile, Pip decided to leave his heaviest stones right there on the path for others to find.
scenes.visual: paws gently unloading smooth gray stones onto the rich dark soil next to a fern

scenes.narration: As soon as he stood back up, he felt light as a feather and skipped all the way home.
scenes.visual: dynamic action shot of the hedgehog bounding cheerfully along a sun-dappled path with a nearly empty bag

scenes.narration: Sometimes letting go of excess weight helps our spirits soar.
scenes.visual: peaceful dusk scene of the little hedgehog entering a warm glowing burrow under roots

scenes.narration: Follow along for more gentle bedtime stories every single day.
scenes.visual: warm glowing close-up of a friendly woodland creature waving happily toward the camera
